text:
aj: Quick check — customer's private VPC OTLP stream is spiking. Prom ingest and Grafana panels show ~3x baseline traces. Any quick knobs to reduce noise or where to look in the tenant's dashboards? :eyes:

maria: Which tenant? I can pull links. Is this the acme-corp VPC with proxy egress? If so their OTLP goes through proxy-collector1.

aj: yes acme-corp, proxy-collector1 in us-west-2. Alert fired on trace_ingest_rate > 2000/s. Where do I check raw OTLP rate?

maria: Grafana (Observability -> Tenants -> acme-corp) -> 'OTLP Ingest' panel. Link: https://grafana.internal/d/omn/otlp-ingest?var-tenant=acme-corp

leo: Quick mitigation: enable tail-based sampling on the otel collector, or lower parentbased probabilistic sampler. Example snippet:

``nprocessors:
  tail_sampling:
    decision_wait: 5s:
    policies:
      - name: reduce-noise:
        type: tail_based:
        sampling_percentage: 5
```

sophie: For prom metrics, check the collector's exposed /metrics on port 8888 (collector pods in privvpc namespace). If it's traces overload, turning on batch span processor batch_size/batch_timeout helps too.

sam: Logs: Loki has the customer's forwarder label = acme-corp-proxy. Query: `{job="promtail", tenant="acme-corp"}`. Promtail config sometimes has rate-limits — check /etc/promtail/config.yaml on the forwarder host.

aj: Thanks. Any change needed on our edge rate-limiter? Currently edge-ratelimit for acme-corp = 5000 TPS for traces. We want to throttle earlier.

maria: We can set a per-tenant OTLP sampler at the proxy layer. For immediate relief, reduce edge-ratelimit to 2500 and add probabilistic sampling in collector. I'll open a PR to infra-config.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: infra-config/master -> staging (PR #4321). Status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:

aj: Cool. Can someone paste the alert rule path? I'll add a note in the incident.

maria: It's in prometheus/rules/tenant_alerts.yaml -> trace_ingest_high. Link: https://grafana.internal/alerts/2034

leo: Follow-up — post-change, monitor these panels for 10m: ingest rate, dropped spans, tail-sampled rate. I'll add a short dashboard row next to the existing OTLP graph. :thumbsup:

aj: Awesome, ping me when PR lands. thx
